libucw-xml.source_sha256_evidence: SHA-256 of the upstream release tarball libucw-6.5.tar.gz (Last-Modified 2015-07-17), downloaded 2026-11-18 and checked by the Dockerfile; the detached libucw-6.5.tar.sign was not verified (no pinned signing key)
libucw-xml.package: LibUCW 6.5 (Martin Mares, Pavel Charvat et al.); ucw-xml is its XML parser. The tarball's own debian/ packaging (control.in, rules) builds the binaries libucw-xml@UCW_ABI_SUFFIX@ and libucw-xml-dev, with UCW_ABI_SUFFIX = -6.5 in ucw/default.cfg, i.e. libucw-xml-6.5, the name seen in the popcon snapshot; libucw is not in the Debian archive

libucw-xml.documentation: libucw-6.5/ucw-xml/doc/xml.txt and the documented declarations in ucw-xml/xml.h (also https://www.ucw.cz/libucw/doc/ucw-xml/)
